title: NAT modal interface-label robustness
acceptance_criteria: Source NAT create/edit modals show interface selectors as description-first labels.
Destination NAT create/edit modals show interface selectors as description-first labels.
Static NAT create/edit modals show interface selectors as description-first labels.
VLAN subinterfaces are labeled with description-first fallback behavior when descriptions exist.
NAT API payload values remain canonical interface names.
Frontend validation gates pass (tsc, lint, build, runtime smoke, UI smoke).
assumptions: NAT modal interface options are sourced from running config snapshot and may include non-ethernet interfaces without descriptions.
Label enrichment should remain display-only and not change backend command semantics.
Existing unrelated working tree changes remain untouched.

tasks.notes: Added description hydration + formatted display labels for all NAT interface selectors.
Executed frontend tsc/lint/build + runtime/browser smoke checks.
Manual verification pending on live NAT create/edit forms.
